skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: an elegy
skins.content: Witch Feast Series/an elegy. An outfit tailored for Nightingale. Who is the one who sings, and what language is it in? Whose dream do I see, and whose death do I see?
skins.quote: An ancient elegy from the twilight.

skins.name: Iakhu of Flows
skins.content: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Iakhu of Flows. In a naptime dream adorned with gold, the earth swells beneath Liz's feet, supporting a homeland. The sphere of the heavens turns above her head, spilling its golden rays upon her.
skins.quote: Bathed in the brilliant flows, Liz sees some beautiful possibilities—but it all comes to an end once she wakes.
